verdict.rationale: PayPal can run fully headless. Client-ID/secret credentials are exchanged for access tokens to call the REST APIs from backend systems, and the Disputes and Invoicing APIs are explicitly positioned for programmatic automation. A self-contained sandbox environment supports non-production runs, and the MCP server runs non-interactively via `npx -y @paypal/mcp` configured purely with environment variables (PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), an official general-purpose CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
